_comment: @rolldown/binding-win32-x64-msvc is declared in optionalDependencies as a workaround for npm's optional-dep bug (https://github.com/npm/cli/issues/4828) where Vite 8's rolldown internals fail to install the platform binary automatically. Placing it in optionalDependencies (not devDependencies) means npm's platform-skip checks omit it on Linux/macOS/CI/Vercel runners — so non-Windows installs are unaffected. NOTE: on Node <20.19, npm also skips this entry via engine-check, so Windows local dev on Node 20.18 must either upgrade Node to 20.19+/22.12+ (matches Vercel runtime) OR run `npm install --save-dev @rolldown/binding-win32-x64-msvc` manually as a one-shot. Vercel's default Node 22 satisfies the engine constraint, so the deploy path installs the binding correctly. Remove this entire field once Vite/Rolldown ship a fix.
name: v5
